pattern.description: A wheel-picker list of LLM model names scrolls downward beside the 'LLM' settings card; the centre slot sits under a white selection pill behind the cursor, moving from Gemini 1.0 Pro to Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Items darken as they approach the centre and fade toward the top and bottom mask edges, while the gradient orb keeps spinning.
pattern.why_premium: The picker turns a plain dropdown into a smooth 3D-feeling wheel: a single eased scroll with an opacity gradient keyed to distance from centre and a fixed selection pill reads as 'many models to choose from' in under half a second, synced to the word 'LLMs'.

build_hint.gsap: Stack list items in a column inside a container with a vertical opacity mask (linear-gradient mask-image). gsap.to(list, {y: '+=N*rowHeight', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); onUpdate set each item's opacity and color from |itemCenterY - slotCenterY| (1 at centre, ~0.25 at edges). Selection pill and cursor stay fixed; the orb runs a separate infinite gsap.to(orb, {rotation: 360, repeat: -1, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 13], [0, N*rowHeight], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) or spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) for no overshoot; per item opacity = interpolate(abs(itemY - slotY), [0, 3*rowHeight], [1, 0.25]); orb rotate = frame * k degrees.

notes: Could also be read as input_text_cycle (the selected value cycles through alternatives); chose masked_scroll because the whole list visibly scrolls inside a fading mask. Orb change classed as rotate+color_shift from the gradient pattern; it may be a shader distortion rather than true rotation. Cursor appears static, not listed.
